<!-- Generated by scripts/api-reference.mjs from src/data/openapi.json: do not edit, run `task refs`. -->

- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/{kind}/{item_id}/publish` — Publish an issuer, verifier or mediator: its DID resolves, the catalogue lists it
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/{kind}/{item_id}/unpublish` — Take one back to a draft: its DID stops resolving, the catalogue drops it
- `DELETE /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/{kind}/{item_id}` — Delete an issuer, verifier or mediator, and its identity

## Publish an issuer, verifier or mediator: its DID resolves, the catalogue lists it

`POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/{kind}/{item_id}/publish` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | path | `issuers`, `verifiers`, `mediators` |  |
| `item_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |
| `tenant_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [ItemDetail](/reference/api/schemas/#itemdetail) |
| 403 | [`not_admin`](/reference/errors/#not_admin) |
| 409 | [`identity_pending`](/reference/errors/#identity_pending): its identity is not signed yet; [`tenant_pending`](/reference/errors/#tenant_pending): the tenant's DID is not signed yet |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |
